title: Language-Specific Linguistic Ontology
description: Schema for a single-language instance of the base linguistic ontology (e.g. OntoKon.json for Konabère). Extends base-ontology.schema.json: same seven core GOLD modules, plus language-identifying metadata and a Lexicon_Overview section. Closed at the top level (unevaluatedProperties: false) so a language instance may only contain meta, the seven base sections, and Lexicon_Overview.

LanguageMeta.description: Metadata for a language-specific ontology instance. Extends the base Meta contract with fields identifying which language this document describes.

language_name.description: Human-readable language name, e.g. "Konabère (Bobo Madaré Nord)".

classification.description: Genetic classification path, e.g. "Niger-Congo, Mande, Western, ...".

speaker_population.description: Speaker count as a string (kept as free text since sources report it with varying precision/qualifiers).

dialects.description: Short flat list of dialect names; a richer per-dialect record (location, notes) may additionally appear inside Core_Foundations.
